theme_archetype.rationale: Matches the 'Netflix-quality' requirement, feeling authoritative, emotional, and premium to justify the ₹199 paywall and alleviate user anxiety with high production value.

headings.description: Used for all headings. 'Outfit' provides a very geometric, modern, cinematic feel.

body.description: Clean, highly readable humanist sans for the questionnaire and dense report data.

accent.description: Used ONLY for score numbers, progress percentages, and overlines (e.g., 'SUCCESS SCORE: 85%').

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-extrabold leading-tight

background.description: Deep cinematic navy. Avoid pure black to maintain richness.

surface.description: Use 'Crystal' glassmorphism for floating navs and locked content overlays. Solid dark navy for questionnaire cards.

accent.description: Gold/Amber to signify premium quality, unlocking, and success. Used for CTAs, progress bars, and lock icons.

grid_modes.features: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 (Bento layout for 'What's Inside')

hero.style: Cinematic depth. Dark navy/gold abstract texture background with a heavy radial gradient overlay to fade edges into #040914.
hero.layout: Centered alignment for emotional impact. H1 -> Subheadline -> Primary CTA Button.

cta_button.style: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#F59E0B] to-[#D97706] text-white font-bold rounded-none shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(245,158,11,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(245,158,11,0.5)] transition-all px-8 py-4 text-lg
cta_button.shape: Slightly rounded corners (rounded-md) to maintain premium feel, avoiding overly pill-shaped generic SaaS look.

questionnaire_card.style: Flat solid background (#091226) with 1px border-white/10. No heavy glassmorphism here to keep focus on the inputs.
questionnaire_card.inputs: Use Shadcn Slider for 1-10 scales, Select/Cards for choices.

lock_overlay.overlay_style: absolute inset-0 z-20 backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#040914]/70 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 border-t border-white/10
lock_overlay.icon: Lucide Lock icon, text-amber-500, w-12 h-12 mb-4 drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(245,158,11,0.5)]

bento_grid.style: Use for 'What's Inside Premium Report'. Glass cards with border-white/5. Spans: 1 large hero card (col-span-full md:col-span-8), 2 smaller feature cards.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5. Colors: white for general, amber-500 for success/premium indicators.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: IMPLEMENT lenis for premium smooth scroll momentum.
motion_and_interactions.reveal: Use framer-motion. Staggered fade-up (initial opacity 0, y 20) for all text and cards on scroll.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Progress bar in the questionnaire must animate smoothly (width transition).

hero_background.description: Abstract black/brown/gold painting. Use as a deeply darkened, low-opacity background for the hero section to give cinematic texture.
hero_background.usage: Hero section background (wrapped in heavy vignette)

transformation_student.description: Man with glasses looking forward in the dark. Cinematic and confident.
transformation_student.usage: Use in the 'Transformation / Before-After' section to represent clarity and confidence.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. FRAMEWORK: Use React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and pure HTML structure for layout freedom.
2. THEME: The site is exclusively DARK MODE. Set backgrounds to #040914 (deep navy).
3. HERO SECTION: Implement a cinematic, emotional hero. Use the provided hero_background image with a heavy CSS overlay (`bg-[#040914]/80`) so it barely peeks through.
4. QUESTIONNAIRE: Build a multi-step interactive form. Use Shadcn for Slider, Select, RadioGroups. Include a dynamic progress bar at the top.

5. PREVIEW SECTION: Show top 3 mocked career matches. Below that, physically render a 'mock' premium report but overlay it with a `backdrop-blur-2xl` div containing the lock icon and 'Unlock Full Blueprint for ₹199' CTA.
6. SPACING: Use generous margins (`py-24`). Avoid tight crammed boxes.
7. COMPONENTS: Avoid Shadcn Card wrappers for marketing sections; use raw `div` elements with Tailwind classes for bento grids.
8. PAYMENT: Integrate a mocked Razorpay checkout modal that triggers on the ₹199 CTA.
9. TEST IDS: Add `data-testid` attributes to all buttons, form inputs, and major sections.
10. FONTS: Import 'Outfit' (weights 300,500,700,800), 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (400,500,600), and 'Space Mono' (400) from Google Fonts.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white text over dark navy meets APCA contrast guidelines. CTA text must be legible against amber.
